note: Uzbekistan: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa (the former Soviet neighbours without limit, Kyrgyzstan 60 days, the long list 30, Hong Kong and Macao 10); those on the e-Visa list apply online (30 days). Indians enter visa-free only with certain third-country visas (not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
